audit.whatIsWrong: Text called Sejuani 'immobile', called her slows 'permafrost slows', claimed Winter's Wrath does percent-HP damage, and said Ragnarok 'cleanses' her CC. Permafrost is the E stun itself, not a stack or a slow; Frost stacks come from Winter's Wrath; W's Riot text is damage + slow + Frost stacks with no percent-HP; Ragnarok's text grants immunity to disables while he keeps attacking, not a cleanse.
audit.why: Sejuani has Arctic Assault, a 650-range charge with a knock-up on an 18s rank-1 cooldown, so 'immobile' is the exact wrong read — and an 18s window after she spends it is the real trading rule. Fury of the North also grants slow immunity, so the first Undertow slow does nothing until Frost Armor has been broken by damage: that is the decisive interaction the page never stated.
audit.corrected: Named Arctic Assault with its 18s cooldown, stated Frost Armor's slow immunity, corrected Permafrost to a full-Frost-stack stun, removed the percent-HP claim, and replaced 'cleanses' with Riot's own immunity-while-attacking wording.

edits.before: Sejuani is an immobile tank with no early kill pressure, and that is exactly what your kit eats. Open with Q to stick the slow, walk up, and weave E for guaranteed true damage that her armor does nothing against. The only thing to respect is her E-stun proc once she has permafrost stacks, so do not trade into it raw, bait it out, then your W-omnivamp commits the next trade and out-sustains her chip.
edits.after: Sejuani has exactly one gap-closer, Arctic Assault, and at 18s on rank 1 she cannot reach you again for a long time once she spends it — bait it, then trade. Note Fury of the North makes her slow-immune out of combat, so your first axe only bites after she has already taken damage. Respect Permafrost: it stuns only at full Frost stacks, so bait the stacks out, then commit your Tough It Out trade.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 are your takeover. Your Q-reset slows keep her glued in place while E nukes through her tankiness, and your passive ramps attack speed as her W chips you. At 6 Ragnarok is the whole matchup, it cleanses her E-stun, R-AOE and permafrost slows, so you all-in or tower-dive unstoppable through every CC she has. Force the kill or burn her Flash here, because every plate and kill you take is a lead she cannot scale back into lane.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 are your takeover. Your Q-reset slows keep her glued in place while E nukes through her tankiness, and your passive ramps attack speed as Winter's Wrath chips you. At 6 Ragnarok is the whole matchup: while you keep attacking you are immune to disables, so Permafrost and Glacial Prison cannot stop the all-in or the tower dive. Force the kill or burn her Flash here, because every plate you take is a lead she cannot scale back into lane.

edits.before: Late game is the one place she gets even. Sejuani's R-AOE stun is a five-man teamfight ult while your flat E true damage and short-trade kit lose value once carries are full-build. Do not let the game drift to 35-minute teamfights where she peels for someone, instead convert your lane lead into towers, Heralds and dives before 2+ items so the map is already won when her engage comes online.
edits.after: Late game is the one place she gets even. Glacial Prison stuns from 1300 range on a 90s rank-3 cooldown while your flat E true damage and short-trade kit lose value once carries are full-build. Do not let the game drift to 35-minute teamfights where she peels for someone, instead convert your lane lead into towers, Heralds and dives before 2+ items so the map is already won when her engage comes online.

notes: Olaf's Undertow carries a 'grounding' flag in the kit file, but Riot's own description says only that he throws an axe into the ground — the flag is a tooltip-parsing artifact (the mirror on another matchup found the same false derivation on Mordekaiser). No grounding claim was written into this matchup as a result, even though Arctic Assault is a dash. Mirror (audits/top/sejuani__olaf.json) already established the same two kit facts from the other side; restated here in Olaf's voice rather than re-researched. Whether Ragnarok removes an already-applied Permafrost stun or only blocks new disables is not in Riot's text, so nothing asserts it — same call the mirror made.
